title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Blueberry Cherry Cranberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Blueberry Cherry Cranberry combines three classic fruit flavours into one irresistibly rich and tangy mix. Juicy Blueberry adds a deep sweetness, balanced by the bold, dark notes of Cherry and the sharp tartness of Cranberry. The result is a meticulously layered and intensely satisfying vape with a smooth yet punchy fruit finish. Perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid provides rapid nicotine satisfaction with a consistently smooth throat hit. The 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures well-defined flavour while keeping vapour production discreet, making it an excellent choice for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids offer a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, bringing familiar and satisfying flavours to a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for convenience.
